sarah: Quick ask before webinar tomorrow — can eng/runtime do a rapid sanity spot-run of the launch benchmark using the final quantized profile and the warmup from staging? Need slide-ready P50/P95 tokens/s, coldstart heatmap, and a tiny CSV of per-model latencies. Also want to validate webinar signup lead routing: sample payloads should hit Dedicated region and generate webhook events to SFDC. cc @aj @mike :pray:
aj: We can run a spotprobe. Which model + quant profile exactly? Also what's the target concurrency and batch caps? Need sample payloads (we'll scrub PII) and a run window (how fast do you need results).
sarah: Model: rdlw-3b-quant-v2 (final). Warmup: 50 requests @512 tokens. Concurrency: 8, batch-cap: 12. Use the prompt pack I linked in the marketing notes (scrubbed): https://internal/redwood/benchpacks/webinar-final. For lead routing, use test-team@redwood.test and map to webhook wf-2026-webinar-01. Need artifacts within ~6h if possible.
mike: Quick ops note — please do a normal run + an explicit cold-sweep (empty KV cache) to capture coldstart heatmap. Minimal runbook suggestion: ```run --model rdlw-3b-quant-v2 --profile webinar-spotprobe --warmup 50 --concurrency 8 --batch-cap 12 --cold-sweep-iterations 30```
aj: Good call. We'll do both. Output pack will include: p50/p95 tokens/s, avg token-cost, coldstart percentiles, per-request latency CSV, and a short anomalies note. I'll annotate traces with the webhook test id so marketing can pull an example event.
bench-bot: Job scheduled: spotprobe-1765439998-rlz started on d-03 (quantized) — ETA ~4h. Link: https://jobs.redwood/spotprobe/1765439998 :robot_face:
lina: Also snapshot the routing logs (headers + event id) so we can show a sample event in the demo. If routing falls back, please record fallback to rdlw-3b-fp16 and call it out in the summary.
aj: Copy — starting runs now. I'll post artifacts (CSV + short one-paragraph summary) and any notable traces here when done. If we hit anything odd I'll tag you, sarah. :thumbsup:
